mainEntity.name: What is the difference between traditional SEO and AI-powered SEO for pool contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO relies on manual research and best practices, often involving human analysis of keywords and content. AI-powered SEO, however, uses advanced algorithms to process vast amounts of data, identify complex patterns, and automate parts of the optimization process. For pool contractors, this means AI can uncover highly specific, long-tail keywords, analyze competitor strategies at scale, and predict search trends with greater accuracy. This results in a more dynamic, data-driven, and often more effective strategy than traditional, manual methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO is manual; AI SEO uses algorithms to analyze vast data, automate optimization, and predict trends for more precise and effective strategies for pool contractors.
